title: The Effect of Square Dance on Rheumatoid Arthritis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to observe the effect of square dance on rheumatoid arthritis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* had wrist and/or MCP involvement
* aged 18 years diagnosed by rheumatology consultants with RA

Exclusion Criteria:

* severe psychological difficulties
* currently receiving mental health care
* any medical condition that might prevent them from safely exercising (e.g. history of more severe heart, lung or cerebrovascular disease)
* previously attended an education programme
* had a Modified Health Assessment Questionnaire score above 2 (0-3)
